caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with a curved backrest made up of several vertical spindles. The chair is predominantly brown in color, with yellow decorative lines accenting the legs, spindles, and edges of the seat and backrest. At the top of the backrest, there is a rectangular panel adorned with a floral design featuring red and pink flowers with green leaves. The legs are slightly splayed and connected by horizontal and diagonal support bars. The seat of the chair is contoured, and the wood grain is visible beneath the painted decorations. The background is plain and off-white, and the name "HENRY ZWYSEN" appears in small blue text near the bottom left of the image.
title: Pa. German Chair
